mapper.sql: select qr.record_id, qr.resident_id, qr.template_id, qr.answer_content, qr.total_score, qr.is_focus_group, qr.surveyor_id, qr.fill_time, qr.create_time, qr.remark, r.real_name as resident_name, r.id_card_no, CONCAT(p.region_name, c.region_name, d.region_name, s.region_name, cm.region_name) as full_region_name, t.template_name, sv.real_name as surveyor_name from gc_questionnaire_record qr left join gc_resident r on qr.resident_id = r.resident_id left join gc_region p on r.province_id = p.region_id left join gc_region c on r.city_id = c.region_id left join gc_region d on r.district_id = d.region_id left join gc_region s on r.street_id = s.region_id left join gc_region cm on r.community_id = cm.region_id left join gc_questionnaire_template t on qr.template_id = t.template_id left join gc_surveyor sv on qr.surveyor_id = sv.surveyor_id
mapper.select: select record_id, resident_id, template_id, answer_content, total_score, is_focus_group, surveyor_id, fill_time, create_time, remark from gc_questionnaire_record where record_id = #{recordId}

select record_id, resident_id, template_id, answer_content, total_score, is_focus_group, surveyor_id, fill_time from gc_questionnaire_record where resident_id = #{residentId} and template_id = #{templateId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into gc_questionnaire_record( resident_id, template_id, answer_content, total_score, is_focus_group, surveyor_id, fill_time, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{residentId}, #{templateId}, #{answerContent}, #{totalScore}, #{isFocusGroup}, #{surveyorId}, #{fillTime}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from gc_questionnaire_record where record_id in
#{recordId}
